name: Pivot Footwork & Finishing
summary: Warm up your hands, shoot off strong pivots, protect the ball on finishes, then make free throws while tired.

drills.name: Ball Wrap Warm-Up
drills.summary: Wake up your hands by moving the ball fast around your body before you dribble.
steps: Wrap the ball around your head 10 times each way.
Wrap it around your waist 10 times each way.
Wrap it around both knees, then each leg, 10 times each way.
Finish with 30 seconds of hard pounds, right then left, eyes up.

drills.name: Pivot Rip Jumpers
drills.summary: Catch, pivot, rip the ball through and shoot on balance.
steps: Spin the ball out to yourself at the elbow and catch on two feet.
Front pivot to face the rim, then rip the ball low across your knees.
Rise into a balanced jumper from the elbow.
Next rep, use a reverse pivot. Switch elbows every 5 shots.

drills.name: Low-Pocket Gather Finishes
drills.summary: Gather the ball low and away from the help, then finish high off the glass.
steps: Set a cone on the block as a help defender.
Attack from the wing with one or two hard dribbles.
Gather the ball low on your outside hip, away from the cone.
Bring it up high and finish off the glass with your outside hand.
Do 5 makes each side, then switch blocks.

drills.name: Miss-and-Run Free Throws
drills.summary: Shoot free throws while tired and pay for every miss with a sprint.
steps: Sprint baseline to half court and back to start the round.
Walk to the line and shoot 2 free throws.
Make both: rest 10 seconds. Miss one: sprint baseline to half court and back.
Keep going until time runs out. Count your makes.
